title: Conformal cyclic cosmology
example_questions: What happened before the Big Bang?
summary: The universe passes through an endless chain of aeons. When an aeon is so far in the future that only massless radiation remains, it has no sense of scale and can be mathematically identified with the Big Bang of the next aeon. Penrose and collaborators claim traces of the previous aeon (circles and Hawking points) in the cosmic microwave background.
support_note: Claimed CMB evidence has been disputed by independent analyses.
what_happens: An aeon expands until only radiation is left
Its infinite future becomes the next Big Bang
Black hole evaporation in the old aeon leaves Hawking points in the new sky

key_numbers.name: Confidence of Hawking point excess after reanalysis

objections: Requires all massive particles to eventually lose mass
Independent CMB analyses find no significant signal
